G‑Cloud Framework Suppliers in the UK: How CODM Can Help with Cloud Support

Finding the right cloud support partner is an important decision for public sector organisations. Requirements can range from improving an existing platform and connecting systems to migrating data, developing cloud applications, introducing AI automation or providing specialist technical support.

For organisations looking for G‑Cloud framework suppliers in the UK, G‑Cloud 15 provides a route to access suppliers offering cloud-based services. For requirements involving professional cloud support, G‑Cloud 15 Lot 3: Cloud Support can be particularly relevant.

CODM Software Limited is a supplier on the G‑Cloud 15 framework, RM1557.15, Lot 3: Cloud Support. We provide cloud-specific professional services across Salesforce, AI, integration, data and cloud application development.

This guide explains what G‑Cloud 15 Lot 3 covers and how CODM can help public sector organisations address practical cloud technology requirements.

What is G‑Cloud 15?

G‑Cloud 15 is a UK public sector framework for cloud-based services. It provides eligible public sector organisations with access to suppliers offering services across cloud hosting, cloud software and cloud support.

The framework is divided into different lots, allowing buyers to identify suppliers and services that are relevant to their requirements.

Lot 3 is the Cloud Support lot. It covers cloud-specific professional services delivered for a defined period and can support activities such as planning, implementation, integration, development, migration, optimisation and technical improvement.

For organisations that already have cloud technology in place but need specialist expertise to improve, integrate, develop or support it, Lot 3 can provide a relevant procurement route.

How CODM Can Help Under G‑Cloud 15 Lot 3

CODM supports organisations that need practical technical expertise to make better use of their cloud platforms and connected systems.

Our focus is not simply on implementing technology. We work with organisations to understand the existing environment, identify the technical or operational challenge and provide the specialist support required to achieve the desired outcome.

Our Cloud Support capabilities include:

  • Salesforce advisory, implementation and optimisation
  • AI, Agentforce and intelligent automation
  • API and system integration
  • Data integration and data migration
  • Cloud-connected application development
  • React and Microsoft .NET development
  • Deployment and technical troubleshooting
  • Performance optimisation and continuous improvement

Salesforce Cloud Support

Many organisations already rely on Salesforce as a core platform but need additional expertise to improve how it is configured, integrated and used.

CODM can support public sector organisations with Salesforce advisory, implementation and optimisation services.

Salesforce Advisory and Optimisation

We can review an existing Salesforce environment and help identify opportunities to improve functionality, processes, integrations and user experience.

Salesforce Implementation and Development

Where new Salesforce capabilities are required, CODM can provide technical implementation and development support aligned with the organisation’s requirements.

Salesforce Integration

Salesforce often needs to exchange information with other applications and data sources. CODM can help design and implement integrations that connect Salesforce with the wider technology environment.

AI, Agentforce and Intelligent Automation

AI is increasingly becoming part of how organisations deliver services, automate processes and provide better access to information. However, introducing AI effectively requires more than simply selecting a new tool.

CODM can help organisations explore and implement practical AI and automation capabilities where they can provide measurable value.

Agentforce Support

For organisations using Salesforce, CODM can provide support around Agentforce and intelligent capabilities that can help automate tasks, improve access to information and support service teams.

Workflow Automation

We can help identify processes that involve repetitive manual work and assess where automation could improve efficiency, consistency and the user experience.

Practical AI Implementation

Our approach focuses on applying AI to a genuine business or service requirement rather than introducing AI simply for the sake of adopting new technology.

API and Cloud Integration

Public sector organisations often work with multiple systems, platforms and sources of data. Connecting these systems effectively can be essential to improving service delivery.

CODM provides API and integration services to help cloud platforms communicate with other applications and systems.

Our support can include:

  • API development and integration
  • Connecting cloud applications
  • System-to-system data flows
  • Integration with Salesforce and other platforms
  • Integration troubleshooting and improvement

By improving how systems communicate, organisations can reduce manual processes, improve data availability and create a more connected technology environment.

Data Integration and Migration

Data is often spread across multiple applications, databases and platforms. Moving or connecting that data requires careful planning to protect data quality and minimise disruption.

CODM can support organisations with data integration and migration requirements as part of a wider cloud support programme.

Data Migration

We can provide technical support for moving data between systems while considering data structures, transformation requirements and data quality.

Data Integration

Where information needs to flow between multiple systems, CODM can help develop integration approaches that provide reliable and maintainable data flows.

Improving Data Accessibility

Better-connected data can help teams access the information they need without relying on unnecessary manual processes or disconnected systems.

Cloud Application Development

Sometimes an organisation’s requirement cannot be met through an existing platform alone. A bespoke cloud-connected application may be needed to provide a specific user experience, workflow or service.

CODM provides cloud application development using technologies including React and Microsoft .NET.

We can support organisations with application development requirements ranging from new cloud-connected applications to enhancements and integrations around existing systems.

React Development

React can be used to create responsive user interfaces and applications that provide a modern experience for users.

Microsoft .NET Development

Our .NET capabilities support the development of robust applications and services that can connect with existing cloud platforms, APIs and data sources.

Application Integration

Where an application needs to work alongside existing systems, we can help design and implement the required integrations.

Technical Support, Deployment and Continuous Improvement

Cloud projects do not necessarily end when a system goes live. Organisations may need continued technical support to troubleshoot issues, deploy changes, improve performance and adapt systems as requirements evolve.

CODM can provide technical support across the lifecycle of a cloud solution.

This can include:

  • Technical troubleshooting
  • Deployment support
  • System improvements
  • Performance optimisation
  • Enhancements and development
  • Integration support
  • Ongoing technical improvement

This approach allows organisations to access specialist expertise when it is needed while continuing to work with their existing internal teams.

Why Work with CODM?

Choosing a G‑Cloud supplier is not only about finding a company with the right list of technologies. The supplier also needs to understand the organisation’s existing environment and the outcome the project is intended to achieve.

CODM takes a practical, outcome-focused approach to cloud support.

Specialist Technical Expertise

Our capabilities span Salesforce, AI, integration, data and cloud application development, allowing us to support requirements that involve multiple technologies.

Support for Existing Technology Environments

We understand that organisations may already have established platforms, applications, integrations and data sources. Our services can be delivered around those existing environments rather than assuming everything needs to be replaced.

Practical Delivery

We focus on understanding the requirement first and then defining an appropriate technical approach. This helps ensure that the proposed solution is proportionate to the problem being addressed.

Ongoing Improvement

Our involvement does not have to stop at implementation. We can continue to support technical improvements, optimisation, troubleshooting and enhancements as requirements develop.

When Could CODM’s G‑Cloud Cloud Support Services Help?

CODM’s Lot 3 Cloud Support services may be relevant if your organisation needs to:

  • Improve or extend an existing Salesforce implementation
  • Connect Salesforce or other cloud platforms with existing systems
  • Integrate or migrate data
  • Develop a cloud-connected React or Microsoft .NET application
  • Introduce workflow automation or AI capabilities
  • Explore Salesforce Agentforce
  • Resolve technical or integration issues
  • Improve application or platform performance
  • Deploy enhancements to an existing cloud environment
  • Access specialist technical expertise alongside an internal team

The appropriate service will depend on the specific requirement, existing technology environment and intended outcome.

How We Approach a Cloud Support Requirement

Every organisation starts from a different position, so CODM begins by understanding the requirement and the existing technology environment.

Our approach can be summarised as:

  1. Understand the requirement: We establish what the organisation is trying to achieve and the challenges that need to be addressed.
  2. Review the existing environment: We consider the platforms, systems, data and integrations already in place.
  3. Define the technical approach: We identify the appropriate technologies, services and delivery approach.
  4. Provide specialist support: Our team delivers the required advisory, development, integration or technical services.
  5. Improve over time: Where required, we continue to support optimisation, enhancements and technical improvement.

This provides a flexible way for organisations to bring in specialist cloud expertise without necessarily replacing their existing technology or internal teams.

Is CODM a G‑Cloud 15 Lot 3 Supplier?

Yes. CODM Software Limited has been named as a supplier on the Government Commercial Agency’s RM1557.15 G‑Cloud 15 framework, Lot 3: Cloud Support.

This means eligible public sector organisations can consider CODM’s relevant Cloud Support services through the framework, subject to the applicable procurement requirements and service scope.

Our focus is on providing cloud-specific professional services across Salesforce, AI, integration, data and cloud application development.
